name: Sanctum Internet
summary: Internet/web presence provider (Sanctum Internet Pty Ltd, founded 1995; web page packages); not a retail access ISP (ACN 076 596 104).

events.details: Defunct. Sanctum's retail hosting homepage vanished between mid-2002 and mid-2003; a placeholder page lingering to 2014 does not make it a live ISP.

refs.label: Full retail hosting site still live in mid-2002.
By mid-2003 the site was a 'Coming Soon' placeholder - retail gone; the same placeholder persists through mid-2014.
The proposal's c. 2014 only dates when the placeholder host finally 301'd; company ABN record still updated Dec 2017 - neither is the ISP death.
ABR: SANCTUM INTERNET PTY LTD ACN 076 596 104
